description: Searches Bing web results and returns up to 20 ranked results (title, link, snippet, rank), with market (mkt or cc), safe search and coordinate (lat, lon) targeting. Use it when Bing results are wanted. It does not return page contents (use scrape_url) and does not return Google results (use google_search). A search with no matches is charged; errors are not. Required: query.

cc.description: Two-letter country code, e.g. "us" or "it"; omit for source default, mutually exclusive with mkt. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

count.description: Requested result count, integer 1-50, e.g. 20; actual count varies, omitted uses source default. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

filters.description: Opaque Bing filters copied from a Bing search URL; omitted means no explicit filter. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

first.description: One-based position of the first result, integer at least 1, e.g. 11 to start at the 11th result; default 1. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

lat.description: GPS latitude of the search origin in decimal degrees, e.g. "41.9028"; send with lon; omitted uses source default. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

lon.description: GPS longitude of the search origin in decimal degrees, e.g. "12.4964"; send with lat; omitted uses source default. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

mkt.description: Market as language-COUNTRY, e.g. "en-US" or "it-IT"; omit for source default, mutually exclusive with cc. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

query.description: Required web search keywords, e.g. "what is an api"; no default. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

safeSearch.description: Adult-content filter: Off, Moderate or Strict, e.g. "Strict"; omitted uses source default. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

name: bing_search
title: Bing Search
